descriptionAny: Send a message to members. They get a notification by email and read the message in the app.
descriptionLeader: As class representative, you can send a message to members of your 学年. They get a notification by email and read the message in the app.

audience.label: Send to
audience.cohortHint: Current and former students who selected this 学年.

desc.ROLES: Reaches members in the roles you pick (students, alumni, parents, teachers…).
desc.COHORT: Reaches the students and alumni of the class you pick.

title: Title
bodyHint: Your name and position are shown with the message. The email notification doesn't include the title or message.
confirmSummary: This will reach {recipients} members. {email} get a notification by email, then read the message in the app.
sentSummary: Sent to {recipients} members ({email} notified by email). You can see who has read it in the history.

errors.notAllowed: You can't send to this audience.
errors.limit: You've reached your sending limit. Please try again later.

notifyContentless.subject: [AIS Alumni] You have a new message
notifyContentless.text:
You have a new message from {from}.
Open the app to read it.

historyEmpty: You haven't sent any messages yet.

receipts.title: Read receipts
receipts.legacy: This message was sent before read receipts were recorded, so there is no read status.
receipts.noneRead: No one has read it yet.

manage.title: Manage this message
manage.archivedHint: It's hidden from recipients' “Messages for you”. Restore it to show it again (no new notification).
manage.saved: Saved. Recipients see it marked “Edited” (no new notification).
manage.editHint: Editing doesn't send a new notification.
manage.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? It disappears for recipients and its read receipts are deleted. This can't be undone.
